pain.heading:
Deckbuilding is broken.
And you know it.
pain.hoursText: You open 20 Scryfall tabs, scroll Moxfield for an hour, and still aren’t sure if the deck works.
pain.synergyText: You only find out your combo doesn’t work at the table. In front of three opponents.
pain.expensiveText: You buy the cards, build the deck, and a week later realize you built the wrong gameplan.
pain.curveText: No tool tells you your curve is top-heavy until you’re stuck on 3 lands on turn 6.

product.heading:
Moxfield-level power.
Gemini-level intelligence.
product.description: MagicAIBuilder is the deck building tool you always wished existed — a full-featured deck manager where an AI co-pilot analyzes every card choice, flags synergy gaps, and suggests upgrades in real time.
product.feature1: AI commander analysis — instant synergy scoring on every card you add
product.feature2: Mana curve optimizer with bracket-aware power budgeting
product.feature3: Real-time “What should I cut?” — context-aware removal suggestions
product.feature4: Full format support: Commander, Standard, Pioneer, Modern, Legacy
product.feature5: Import from Moxfield, Archidekt, MTGO, Arena — in one click
product.feature6: Price tracker + budget alternatives with similar power level
product.userPrompt: I need 5 discard engines under $10 for Tinybones. What’s good?
product.aiResponse: Here are 5 high-synergy discard engines for Tinybones, all under $10:
product.aiCard1: Burglar Rat — ETB discard, recurrable with your 4 reanimation spells (synergy: 94%)
product.aiCard2: Liliana’s Specter — flying + each opponent discards, great with your evasion package (92%)
product.aiCard3: Oppression — symmetrical but you benefit more with 8 recursion pieces (97%)
product.aiCard4: Bottomless Pit — repeatable, triggers Tinybones every upkeep (95%)
product.aiCard5: Cunning Lethemancer — low cmc, consistent trigger, fuels your graveyard plan (91%)
product.aiFootnote: Adding all 5 would lower your avg CMC from 3.2 to 2.9 and increase discard density to optimal range.

how.heading:
Three Steps to
Your Best Deck
how.subtitle: No tutorials. No friction. Just open it and build.
how.step1Text: Pick any legendary creature. The AI instantly profiles the archetype, color identity, and top synergy packages for that commander.
how.step2Text: Add cards naturally. Every addition is scored in real time. The AI flags weak links, suggests replacements, and keeps your curve in check.
how.step3Text: One-click export to MTGO, Arena, or your LGS buylist. Your deck is bracket-rated and optimized before you even sleeve it up.

testimonials.heading: What Players Are Saying
testimonials.review1Text: I built a Bracket 4 Tinybones deck in 45 minutes. The AI caught three dead cards I would have never noticed until game night.
testimonials.review2Text: Finally a tool that speaks Commander language. It knows what Bracket 3 means. It knows what ‘goodstuff’ means. It gets it.
testimonials.review3Text: The curve optimizer alone is worth the subscription. My decks have never been this consistent. I’m not going back to Moxfield alone.
